# `Q-24-9` — Image Conversion Failed

> An EMF or WMF image could not be converted to SVG. The original was stored, but browsers can't display it.

## What this means

Word documents often embed vector images as EMF or WMF, which browsers can't show. The importer converts them to SVG in the browser; for this image the conversion failed, so the original file is stored under its own extension.

## Why this happens

- The image uses EMF/WMF records the converter does not support.
- The image is damaged.

## How to fix

The original still works when the document is downloaded as Word or PDF. To show it on a web page, export it from its source application as PNG or SVG and replace the file.
